ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) ventral surface with approximately 15-20% high-intensity (white) pixel distribution concentrated in focal clusters and linear streaks.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dark base pigmentation across entire visible fluke; high-contrast white circular pixel clusters (mottling) localized at the distal tips (left and right margins); extensive network of fine, high-contrast white linear filaments across both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 32 degrees; depth of notch is roughly 12% of total vertical lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-amplitude, irregular serration on the right lobe trailing edge including several distinct peaks and troughs; left lobe shows a more continuous, lower-amplitude micro-serrated boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bilateral upward convex sweep; the trajectory of the right lobe is significantly interrupted by macro-scale irregularities in the trailing edge topography.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of circular, high-intensity white pixel groups located at the extreme lateral tips of both lobes, suggesting localized calcified attachment points or scarring.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive multi-directional network of fine, unaligned linear white pixel disruptions (rake marks) visible across the medial and lateral regions of both fluke lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular tissue loss and jagged indentation on the distal trailing edge of the right lobe; dense concentration of white rake marks across the ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced 'saw-tooth' profile on the outer third of the right lobe trailing edge which deviates significantly from a standard smooth or micro-serrated curve.
